name: Wheelos Masala Flavour
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA) (60%), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALMOLEIN, RICE BRAN), TAPIOCA STARCH, CORN FLOUR, EDIBLE COMMON SALT, DEHYDRATED VEGETABLE POWDER (ONION, GARLIC, TAMARIND), SPICES & CONDIMENTS 2% (DRY MANGO, CHILLI, PEPPER, CUMIN), SUGAR, YEAST EXTRACT, ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 296, INS 330, INS 334), NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (MASALA), FLAVOUR ENHANCER (INS 627, INS 631), ANTICAKING AGENT (INS 551, INS 341 (III)), PAPRIKA EXTRACT (INS 160C).
